podman network create --label com.docker.compose.network=default --label com.docker.compose.project=scale scale_default
podman run -d --name scale-cache --label com.docker.compose.container-number=1 --label com.docker.compose.oneoff=False --label com.docker.compose.project=scale --label com.docker.compose.project.config_files=<DIR>/compose.yaml --label com.docker.compose.project.working_dir=<DIR> --label com.docker.compose.service=cache --network scale_default --network-alias cache redis:7
podman run -d --name scale-worker-1 --label com.docker.compose.container-number=1 --label com.docker.compose.oneoff=False --label com.docker.compose.project=scale --label com.docker.compose.project.config_files=<DIR>/compose.yaml --label com.docker.compose.project.working_dir=<DIR> --label com.docker.compose.service=worker --network scale_default --network-alias worker busybox:1.36 sh -c 'while true; do sleep 1; done'
